_comment: BINDING prefill spec. Only carries what the HF config and the checkpoint CANNOT tell you, plus the few targets the bring-up is graded against. Anything readable from config.json - dims, layer count, attention family, rope, vocab, norm eps, expert counts, checkpoint quantization - is NOT here; read it from the config. Where any existing implementation in the repo conflicts with this file, this file wins.

shapes._note: max_seq_len is the prefill sequence length to bring up (the model's max context). Both values must satisfy % (32 * sp) == 0 - chunk_size is the block-cyclic addressing period of the KV table, so a misaligned value corrupts addresses silently rather than failing.

dataformats._note: ttnn dtype spellings: bfloat16 | bfloat8_b | bfloat4_b | float32. Three independent groups, each with its own default. An empty or absent override inherits that group's default.

acceptance._note: Two spec-wide PCC numbers, applied unchanged to every component test. pcc_target is what every component aims for, while pcc_lower_bound is the assert in every test and below it, the component is not accepted and the stage does not pass. Between the two, the test passes but the component is accepted only after all corectness knobs have been tried
